capped30_first_frame.note: U4b held out at a far pose, REPORT ONLY (no gate): Isaac's first live frame of the capped30 start w1_034 (hollywood, cluttered2; the only capped30 first frames on disk are frame 1 of vs-sim's check3 films, read only) against MuJoCo raw and isaac_fit_v1 at the same pose. The film frame is half scale, JPEG then H.264, with the matched points and arrows drawn on it: both sides are compared at half scale (INTER_AREA, as the film) outside a dilated mask of the overlay colours. The film-artefact floor is the same statistic between the film's goal half and Isaac's goal PNG of the same run (also half scale, masked).

measure.how: each scene x look in a fresh process (tools/u4b_look.py _measure): MujocoScene, the goal capture, the near start's frame, 4 redraws of that frame (renderer + curve timed; the curve alone timed too); statistics against Isaac's pictures (read only)
measure.metrics: MuJoCo ``m`` against Isaac ``i`` (same pose): mean grey, per-channel means, per-channel histogram distance (1-D earth mover's distance between the 256-bin histograms, in grey levels: how far, on average, the grey levels must move to turn one histogram into the other) and the per-pixel mean absolute difference (grey levels).
